title: The Rechabites and the Wine
reflectionText: Jeremiah set bowls full of wine before the Rechabites in Yahweh’s house, and they would not drink, because Jonadab their father had commanded them. Yahweh set their obedience beside a people who had not listened, and promised that Jonadab would not lack a man to stand before him. Whose word do you obey all your days?
editorialNotes: Packet 029 initial writer output. Short-only owner plan. The retelling remains within Jeremiah 35:1-19, renders Jeremiah’s first-person narration in the third person, condenses the room detail of verse 4 and the restatements in verses 8-10 and 16 for length, and ends with the promise to Jonadab in verse 19.
